n: G6 option A · Holding the line
p: Defensive depth. An enemy Human B push (red) stalls in front of tank traps, wire and a marked minefield, while EOD sappers clear a lane. The line behind is trench, sandbags, an ATGM bunker and a Laser CIWS burning a strike drone, with the new SP Howitzer firing in support.
uses: Tank Traps, Barbed Wire, Minefield, EOD Sappers, Trench Line, Sandbag Line, ATGM Bunker, Laser CIWS, SP Howitzer; enemy: Landship, shipped Rebuilt Tank, shipped FPV drone

n: G6 option A · The Machine catches up
p: Machine parity. A Colossus Walker and Hover Tanks cross the river under a Swarm Queen and a Shield Drone. A Nanite Wall, an Arc Pylon and a Relay Lattice hold the Machine bank against a Human A counter-attack (red, shipped MBT and IFV).
uses: Colossus Walker, Hover Tank, Swarm Queen, Shield Drone, Nanite Wall, Arc Pylon, Relay Lattice, Spider Mine Layer; shipped Heavy Walker; enemy: shipped MBT, IFV

p: Carriers and submarines go to sea, with the missing supply ship and mine warfare. A carrier group with a supply ship and minesweeper faces a Machine Lance Cruiser and a lurking submarine (red), while an AWACS watches overhead.
uses: Aircraft Carrier, Supply Ship, Minesweeper, AWACS, Hovercraft; enemy: Lance Cruiser, Attack Submarine

p: An asymmetric faction. Irregulars spring an ambush on a Human A column (red, shipped IFV and MBT) from brush, a tunnel exit and a ruined block, with a technical and a captured tank.
uses: Tunnel Network, Ambush Cell, Technical, Captured Tank, Garrisonable Building; enemy: shipped IFV, MBT, riflemen
